notes: ASV reverses the order of the two closing prepositional phrases; units follow the Hebrew phrase each English phrase renders.

'Oh when' is read with מתי; the competing readings (giving 'Oh' to תבוא as a volitive frame, or marking it added since the verb is a plain imperfect) are named in the unit note. בְּקֶרֶב → 'within' fuses under rule 30; the suffix on לבב is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'a perfect heart' with no possessive.
